_comment: A placeholder, not a trust root.
Until this project has a release pipeline that signs its artifacts, there
is nothing to verify an update against — so this file is deliberately not
a valid sigstore trusted root, and the updater reads that as 'updates are
At release time this is replaced with the real trusted root, fetched with
`cosign trusted-root create` or taken from the sigstore TUF repository.
Until then the application says it cannot verify updates, which is true.
